# Orbit Capital + Intelligence

> For complete information, see [llms-full.txt](https://orbitcapital.ai/llms-full.txt)

> Orbit is an ecosystem of predictive intelligence, operational hedging, and quantitative trading for Latin America, built on prediction markets.

## Core Products

- [Orbit Risk](https://orbitcapital.ai/risk): Operational hedging with prediction markets for businesses exposed to political, regulatory, and macroeconomic uncertainty in LATAM.
- [Orbit Capital](https://orbitcapital.ai/capital): First LATAM quantitative fund specialized in prediction markets. 13 autonomous AI agents, 18% target return, Sharpe >1.5.
- [Our Intelligence](https://orbitcapital.ai/intel): Proprietary internal intelligence platform powering the Orbit ecosystem. Knowledge Graphs, prediction markets, social sentiment, and alternative signals.
